room_name: La salle des révolutions · The revolutions hall

room_name: La salle des révolutions · The revolutions hall
hook: kohn-PLOH: two boys hide behind a giant COMB and whisper their secret PLOT: COMB-PLOT

room_name: La salle des révolutions · The revolutions hall

room_name: La salle des révolutions · The revolutions hall

note: Also used for a bossy person at home or school (Mon petit frère est un vrai tyran).

room_name: La salle des révolutions · The revolutions hall
hook: ehg-ZEEL: sent into EXILE on a tiny island, the man has nothing but EGGS to eat and feels ILL: EGGS-ILL
note: Being forced to live away from your home country, often as a punishment.

room_name: La salle des révolutions · The revolutions hall
hook: fah-nah-TEEK: a FAN in the ATTIC: up on the loft a girl waves a giant foam finger and a team scarf, a true FANATIC: FAN-ATTIC
note: Can be negative (a dangerous extremist) or light (un fanatique de foot: a big soccer fan).

room_name: Les archives · The archives
hook: ahr-kay-oh-loh-ZHEE: in the dig sandpit a girl uncovers a little wooden ARK-chest with a big gold KEY: ARCHAEOLOGY: ARK-KEY

room_name: Les archives · The archives
hook: ahn-see-kloh-pay-DEE: IN a CYCLE round and round: a girl rides a unicycle while reading a giant ENCYCLOPEDIA: IN-CYCLE

room_name: Les archives · The archives
hook: ruh-kohns-tee-tew-SYOHN: grandma reSTITCHes the old-time costumes for the REENACTMENT, and the children already wear them: RE-CON-STITCH
note: Two senses: a historical reenactment (une reconstitution historique) and a reconstruction of events, as in a police inquiry.

room_name: Les archives · The archives
hook: gee-yoh-TEEN: 'GEE, YO!' says the TEEN as the paper GUILLOTINE slices her page clean: GEE-YO-TEEN
note: Historically, the machine used for executions during the French Revolution. Here, a paper cutter (more usually un massicot).

room_name: Les archives · The archives

room_name: Les archives · The archives

room_name: Les archives · The archives
hook: pah-tree-MWAHN: old PAT points to the family TREE painted with portraits: our PATRIMOINE, our heritage: PAT-TREE
note: Heritage, shared by a family or a nation (le patrimoine mondial: world heritage), and also a person's estate.

room_name: Les archives · The archives

room_name: Les archives · The archives
hook: sewl-TAHN: the SULTAN in his gold crown lounges under the hot reading lamp and gets a SUNTAN: SUN-TAN
note: A title of rulers in many Muslim lands, like the Ottoman sultans.

room_name: Les archives · The archives

room_name: La salle de linguistique · The linguistics room

room_name: La salle de linguistique · The linguistics room
hook: see-nyee-fee-kah-SYOHN: a puzzled boy asks the MEANING of a road SIGN that shows a duck with an umbrella: SIGN-IFICATION

room_name: La salle de linguistique · The linguistics room

room_name: La salle de linguistique · The linguistics room

room_name: La salle de linguistique · The linguistics room
hook: vehr-SYOHN: the cardboard robot, VERSION 2, is twice as tall as VERSION 1: VERSION
note: In school, une version is a translation into your own language. At the movies, en VO (version originale) means in the original language with subtitles.

room_name: La salle de linguistique · The linguistics room
hook: ahr-gew-MAHN: the ARGUE-MAN at the podium raises a finger for each ARGUMENT: one, two, three good reasons: ARGUE-MAN

room_name: La salle de linguistique · The linguistics room
hook: TEHRM: a big TERMite on the chalkboard munches a stick to the very END: le terme, the end (and a term): TERMITE
note: Two senses: a term (word), and the end of something (mettre un terme à = to put an end to; à terme = in the long run).

room_name: La salle de linguistique · The linguistics room
hook: pray-TEHKST: his PRETEXT: hands folded as if to PRAY, but really he's hiding his phone to TEXT: PRAY-TEXT
note: Sous prétexte que = on the pretext that; often a little dishonest, an excuse.

room_name: La salle de linguistique · The linguistics room
hook: BYEH: 'BYE!' she waves from the slanting staircase, going down EN BIAIS, at a slant: BYE

room_name: La salle de linguistique · The linguistics room

note: Also grammatical gender (le genre masculin) and a casual filler, 'like' (c'est genre trop bien).

room_name: La salle de linguistique · The linguistics room
hook: SEENY: a girl SIGNS 'hello' to the gray parrot, and it seems to say: SEEN YA!: SEEN-YA

room_name: La salle des langues · The languages room

room_name: La salle des langues · The languages room

room_name: La salle des langues · The languages room

room_name: La salle des langues · The languages room

room_name: La salle des langues · The languages room
hook: por-tew-GEH: a toy TUGboat chugs into PORT in the wading basin, its captain calling out in Portuguese: PORT-TUG
note: Capital P for a person (un Portugais); lowercase for the language and the adjective.

room_name: La salle des langues · The languages room
hook: ah-RAHB: a white RABBIT turns its pages from RIGHT to LEFT, the way ARABIC is written: A-RAB-BIT
note: Also the adjective (les chiffres arabes = the numerals 0–9). Capital A for a person (un Arabe).

room_name: La salle des langues · The languages room
hook: TEWRK: a TURKEY in headphones gobbles along to a TURKISH lesson on the record player: TURK-EY

room_name: La salle du vocabulaire · The vocabulary room
hook: for-mew-lah-SYOHN: she tries a third FORMULATION of her note FOR the MULE; two crumpled drafts already lie on the floor: FOR-MULE

room_name: La salle du vocabulaire · The vocabulary room
hook: ehk-stahn-SYOHN: an EXTENSION cord stretched to full TENSION across the floor: EXTENSION-TENSION

room_name: La salle du vocabulaire · The vocabulary room
hook: ahn-bee-gwee-TAY: AM I BIG? WE argue over TEA: is that drawing a rabbit, or a duck? AMBIGUOUS: AM-BIG-WE-TEA
note: Sans ambiguïté = clearly, unambiguously.

room_name: La salle du vocabulaire · The vocabulary room

room_name: La salle du vocabulaire · The vocabulary room

room_name: La salle de phonétique · The phonetics room
hook: dyah-LEHKT: grandpa turns the DIAL of the old radio until he hears the DIALECT of his home village, and beams: DIAL-ECT

room_name: La salle de phonétique · The phonetics room

note: D'habitude = usually. Avoir l'habitude de = to be used to.

room_name: La salle de psychologie · The psychology room

note: Also a public figure, a celebrity (une personnalité politique).

room_name: La salle de psychologie · The psychology room
hook: psee-koh-loh-ZHEEK: the goalie makes a wild face to PSYCH OUT the kicker: a PSYCHOLOGICAL trick: PSYCH-OUT

room_name: La salle de sociologie · The sociology room
hook: rahn-for-suh-MAHN: the kids RAN in with FORCE to prop up the sagging blanket fort: REINFORCEMENT: RAN-FORCE
note: Also used in psychology (renforcement positif = positive reinforcement) and building (strengthening a wall).

room_name: La galerie · The upper gallery
hook: kah-pah-see-TAY: the toy bus is packed to CAPACITY: a whole CITY of plush animals squeezed in, not one more fits: CAPA-CITY
note: Also ability or skill: la capacité de nager = the ability to swim.

room_name: La galerie · The upper gallery
hook: an-tay-lee-ZHAHNS: the crow drops pebbles into the jug until the water rises to its beak: pure INTELLIGENCE: CLEVER-CROW
note: Also understanding or complicity: être d'intelligence avec quelqu'un = to be in league with someone.

room_name: La galerie · The upper gallery
hook: kohn-pay-TAHNS: she and her friend COMPETE in a TENSE juggling match, but she has all the COMPETENCE: five balls in the air: COMPETE-TENSE
note: Often plural for skills: des compétences. In law, jurisdiction.

room_name: La galerie · The upper gallery
hook: ahp-tee-TEWD: the little painter at the easel is APT TO become a great artist: a natural APTITUDE: APT-TO-TUDE

room_name: La galerie · The upper gallery
hook: pehr-for-MAHNS: the cat would PURR FOR the MANTIS dancing on its hind legs: what a PERFORMANCE: PURR-FOR-MANTIS
note: Usually a result or achievement (a sports record, a machine's output), not a stage show, which is un spectacle or une représentation.

room_name: La galerie · The upper gallery
hook: rah-pee-dee-TAY: the two boys RAP IT back and forth so fast their words blur: RAPIDITY, top speed: RAP-IT-TAY
note: Avec rapidité = quickly.

room_name: La galerie · The upper gallery
hook: sah-vwahr-FEHR: the waiter glides through the crowd with a full tray of FAIR cupcakes and SAVES every one: SAVOIR-FAIRE, smooth know-how: SAVE-WHAT-FAIR
note: Practical know-how; in English it means social grace.

room_name: La galerie · The upper gallery
hook: sah-VWAHR: the SAVVY old tortoise carries a whole library on its shell: all that KNOWLEDGE, its SAVOIR: SAVVY-WAR
note: Also the verb savoir = to know (a fact). Le savoir = learning, knowledge.

room_name: La galerie · The upper gallery
hook: ehk-SPEHR: the librarian is an EXPERT at matching a mountain of shoes into PAIRS in seconds: EX-PAIR
note: Also an adjective: expert en = skilled at. Un expert-comptable = an accountant.

room_name: La galerie · The upper gallery
hook: ehs-PREE: the clown SPRITZes the kids with his little water bottle and cracks a joke: what WIT, what ESPRIT: S-SPRITZ
note: Also mind (l'esprit) and spirit or ghost. Avoir de l'esprit = to be witty.

room_name: Le cabinet d'étude · The brain study
hook: sehr-VEHL: the cook SERVES a cauliflower shaped just like a brain: CERVELLE, brains (on a plate, or in your head): SERVE-ELL
note: La cervelle = brains as food, or colloquially your brain: se creuser la cervelle = to rack one's brains. The organ is le cerveau.

room_name: Le cabinet d'étude · The brain study
hook: an-kohn-SYAHNS: the scientist is so lost IN his SCIENCE tubes he's unaware of the whole room: INCONSCIENCE, unawareness: IN-CON-SCIENCE
note: Unconsciousness, but more often recklessness or thoughtlessness: c'est de l'inconscience! = that's reckless!

room_name: Le cabinet d'étude · The brain study
hook: pray-dee-lehk-SYOHN: she PRAYs for DILL pickles every single day: her PREDILECTION, her favorite: PRAY-DILL
note: De prédilection = favorite: son sujet de prédilection = her favorite subject.

room_name: Le cabinet d'étude · The brain study
hook: PEEL: she PEELs open the toy robot's back to swap its PILE, its BATTERY: PEEL
note: Also a stack or pile; pile ou face = heads or tails; à trois heures pile = at three o'clock sharp.

room_name: Le cabinet d'étude · The brain study
hook: ew-tee-lee-TAY: YOU TILL IT, YOU fix IT: grandpa's tool belt has a gadget for every job: pure UTILITY: YOU-TILL-IT
note: D'utilité publique = of public benefit.

room_name: Le cabinet d'étude · The brain study
hook: psee-kah-nah-LEEST: ANNA the PSYCHOANALYST keeps a LIST of everything the teddy bear on her couch dreams about: PSYCH-ANNA-LIST
note: Same form for a man or a woman: un or une psychanalyste.

room_name: Le cabinet d'étude · The brain study
hook: sehr-VOH: the SERVO robot points across the room at the giant brain and everyone goes 'OH!': CERVEAU, the brain: SERVO-OH
note: Also the mastermind of a plan: le cerveau de l'affaire.

room_name: Le cabinet d'étude · The brain study
hook: kor-TEHKS: a toy T-REX sits right on the wrinkly brain cushion, on its outer layer: COR-T-EX, the CORTEX: CORE-T-REX
note: Le cortex cérébral = the cerebral cortex.

room_name: Le cabinet d'étude · The brain study
hook: oh-toh-mah-TEEZM: next to his toy AUTOs he draws loops like MATISSE without even looking: AUTOMATISM, done on autopilot: AUTO-MATISSE
note: A reflex or habit done without thinking; also automation of a machine.

room_name: Le cabinet d'étude · The brain study
hook: oo-BLEE: OOH! he hunts everywhere for the glasses perched on his own head: OUBLI, forgetfulness: OOH-BLEE
note: A lapse or oversight; tomber dans l'oubli = to fall into oblivion.

room_name: Le cabinet d'étude · The brain study
hook: may-MWAHR: her MÉMOIRE, her thesis, is so huge it starts a MEMO WAR of sticky notes all over the board: MEMO-WAR
note: Le mémoire = a thesis, dissertation or report; les Mémoires = memoirs. La mémoire (feminine) = memory.

room_name: Le centre de ressources · The resource center
hook: kree-TEEK: she eyes the wobbly TEAK stool the boy built and scribbles notes: a stern CRITIQUE, a review: CRIT-TEAK
note: La critique = criticism, a review, or the critics as a group; un or une critique = a critic.

room_name: Le centre de ressources · The resource center
hook: ay-vee-DAHNS: chocolate all over their faces, they swear they didn't eat the cake: it's EVIDENT, une ÉVIDENCE, the obvious: EVIDENT-FACE
note: False friend: une évidence = something obvious; c'est une évidence = it's obvious. Legal evidence is une preuve.

room_name: Le centre de ressources · The resource center
hook: sewg-zhehs-TYOHN: she JESTs that the desk needs more SUGAR, and her SUGGESTION arrives: a frosted cake: SUGAR-JEST

room_name: Le centre de ressources · The resource center
hook: kohn-tan-ZHAHNS: a TIN CAN tips off the top shelf by sheer chance and spills right beside the boy: CONTINGENCE, a chance event: CON-TIN
note: Usually plural: les contingences = everyday constraints, practicalities.

room_name: Le centre de ressources · The resource center
hook: vah-RYAHNT: every big toy ANT on the rug is a VARIed color: so many VARIANTS: VARY-ANT

room_name: Le centre de ressources · The resource center
hook: oh-pee-NYOHN: mouth wide OPEN, he bites the pie and says 'YUM!': that's his OPINION: OPEN-YUM
note: L'opinion publique = public opinion.

room_name: Le centre de ressources · The resource center
hook: rahn-seh-nyuh-MAHN: he asks at the desk about the RENT SIGN he saw and the clerk shows him the map: RENSEIGNEMENT, INFORMATION: RENT-SIGN
note: Often plural: des renseignements = information; les renseignements = the intelligence services.

room_name: Le centre de ressources · The resource center
hook: sahn-tee-MAHN: grandma SENT A MINT tin of old love letters and grandpa beams with tears in his eyes: SENTIMENT, a feeling: SENT-A-MINT
note: A feeling or emotion, not mushiness: j'ai le sentiment que = I have the feeling that.

room_name: Le centre de ressources · The resource center
hook: ro-mah-NEHSK: she ROAMs off into an adventure book, dreaming of the toy castle beside her: LE ROMANESQUE, the stuff of novels: ROAM-AN-ESK
note: Mostly an adjective: romanesque = novelistic, or fanciful and romantic.

room_name: Le centre de ressources · The resource center
hook: dee-SEEPL: the little DISCIPLE sits by his old master and copies everything he does, down to every SIP: DIS-SIP-PULL
note: A follower or pupil of a master or school of thought.

room_name: La salle de la compréhension · The understanding room
hook: kohn-pray-ahn-SYOHN: she kneels to click in the last pieces and suddenly the whole picture makes sense: COMPREHENSION, understanding: LAST-PIECE
note: Also understanding in the sense of sympathy: merci de votre compréhension = thank you for your understanding.

room_name: La salle de la compréhension · The understanding room
hook: kohn-sehp-SYOHN: he designs a rocket shaped like an ice-cream CONE, real cone in hand: his CONCEPTION, his design: CONE-SEPT
note: Design or creation of something, an idea or view of something, and also conception of a child.

room_name: La salle de la compréhension · The understanding room
hook: kohn-few-ZYOHN: she turns her puzzle piece every which way, her brain about to blow a FUSE: total CONFUSION: CON-FUSE
note: Also a mix-up between two things: une confusion de noms = a mix-up of names.

room_name: La salle de la compréhension · The understanding room
hook: krwah-YAHNS: the CROW flaps a little DANCE at the window and she's sure it'll rain, umbrella up: CROYANCE, a BELIEF: CROW-DANCE
note: A belief, often religious or popular: les croyances populaires = folk beliefs.

room_name: La salle de la compréhension · The understanding room
hook: ee-nyoh-RAHNS: he snoozes on his beanbag and IGNOREs the ANTS marching into his basket: blissful IGNORANCE: IGNORE-ANTS
note: Simply not knowing, not necessarily rude: dans l'ignorance de = unaware of.

room_name: La salle de la compréhension · The understanding room
hook: pehr-tee-NAHNS: the PERT little turtle brings exactly the right piece, right on point: PERTINENCE, relevance: PERT
note: Relevance or aptness, not cheekiness (that is l'impertinence).

room_name: La salle de la compréhension · The understanding room
hook: ray-pehr-kew-SYOHN: one bang on his drum and the block stack beside him tumbles: the REPERCUSSIONS: RE-PERCUSSION
note: Usually plural: des répercussions = consequences, knock-on effects.

room_name: La salle de la compréhension · The understanding room
hook: mah-lahn-tahn-DEW: she drew the courier a TENT and he DUly delivered TEN DUCKS: a MALENTENDU, a misunderstanding: TEN-DUCKS
note: From mal (badly) + entendu (heard): a misunderstanding.
